tasks.title: Static bug audit: i18n key parity (en+de) via real parser, dead getElementById wiring, dialog modal/Esc registry completeness, declared-but-missing keyshortcuts
tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt slice 1 — static wiring. The editor has grown by 15 fast feature slices; wiring drift is likely.

VERIFIED STATE OF THE WORLD (probe to confirm):
- i18n.js is a dependency-free module exposing globals (grep 'exposes three globals'); it can be loaded in node to get the real en/de catalogs — do NOT regex-parse it (a naive regex audit produced false positives: keys ARE mostly present).
- KNOWN REAL FINDING already: 18 .dialog-overlay ids are NOT in DIALOG_IDS (bookmark/cc/chart/columns/comment/crossref/equation/field/help/info/mailmerge/object/plugin-unavailable/plugins/settings/smartart/suggest/toc dialogs) — DIALOG_IDS feeds getOpenDialog() (modal Tab-trap). Esc handling is AD-HOC per dialog (grep 'key === "Escape"'). AUDIT: for each of the 18, determine (a) is it opened as modal overlay (openDlg/openOverlayDialog), (b) does it have ANY Esc/overlay-click close path, (c) does the Tab trap apply. Fix: register every modal overlay in DIALOG_IDS; add Esc close where missing; non-modal popovers must be explicitly so (comment like the anchored-insert-popovers one at ~1776).
- KNOWN REAL FINDING: 'find-dialog' is IN DIALOG_IDS but my grep found no `id="find-dialog" class="dialog-overlay"` — probe its actual markup (class order may differ or it's renamed); reconcile.

YOUR DELIVERABLES (fix everything you find, each with a test):
1. Write scripts/audit-i18n.mjs (in the editor dir): loads i18n.js catalogs in node (follow how the module exposes them), extracts every i18n key referenced in index.html (data-i18n, data-i18n-title, data-i18n-aria-label) AND every t("Key") in editor.js, asserts each exists in BOTH en and de; prints missing. Run it, FIX all missing keys (proper de translations, not English copies).
2. Buttons/labels with user-visible text or title but NO data-i18n attributes (grep index.html button tags; exclude dialogs' static scaffolding if covered elsewhere) — add keys en+de. (Known already-fixed examples: home 'Font color'/'Clear style' — there may be more.)
3. Dead wiring: every getElementById('X') in editor.js where X does not exist in index.html AND the result is used unguarded, or guarded to death (handler can never fire). List them, fix (restore id or remove dead handler).
4. aria-keyshortcuts declared in index.html but not handled in editor.js (grep keyshortcuts, cross-check keydown handlers) — implement or remove the declaration.
5. scripts/audit-i18n.mjs must be runnable via node and exits non-zero on missing keys; wire it in as a test file audit-i18n.test.mjs (zero-dep, runs the same checks) so the gate enforces it forever.
6. Commit: 'fix(BUG1-STATIC-AUDIT): i18n parity en+de, dialog modal/Esc registry, dead wiring, keyshortcuts' + body listing every bug fixed.

ALL *.test.mjs green (26 files after this). Worktree layout: you are at the monorepo root; paths above are relative to it.

- Playwright is ALREADY INSTALLED at /home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/node_modules — require by absolute path: require('/home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/node_modules/playwright'). Do NOT npm-install anything.

- The editor boots standalone (prod census proves it). wo-bridge save calls will 404 locally — fine for this slice, catch nothing.

2. Run it. TRIAGE every finding: real bug (fix), by-design (no-op marker — verify marker fired), or harness artifact (server/port/async timing — fix the script). Fix every real bug in editor.js/index.html/i18n.js/style.css. Known-suspect areas from the slices: AF9 chart selection wiring (tab gating state), AF14 writing-mode textdir round-trip, AF15 right-panel section sync on selection change, AF13 plugin cards, AF12 Macros menu open/close.

tasks.title: Serialization safety: save/export HTML round-trip cleanliness with every feature active (spell markers, textdir, content controls, charts, tables, comments, track changes)
tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && for t in *.test.mjs; do node "$t" > /dev/null || { echo "FAIL $t"; exit 1; }; done
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Bug hunt slice 3 — document integrity through the save path. The editor serializes innerHTML for save (grep flatHtml / the save serialization; misspell markers are stripped there — AF11 added stripMisspellMarkers ~4496). Every feature added since must survive this round-trip WITHOUT leaking editor-internal state into saved documents.

VERIFIED STATE (probe to confirm):
- Save path: editor.js flushes HTML (grep the save/flush function near wo-bridge POST); sanitizer allowlist governs surviving attrs (~2720 area, grep 'script', 'style', 'iframe' block list / attr allowlist). AF14 noted data-textdir must be allowlisted — VERIFY it actually is.
- Features that mark up the DOM: wo-misspelled spans, data-textdir attrs + CSS classes, content controls (btn-contentcontrol model), chart/equation/smartart objects (img[data-kind][data-spec]), comments (spans with data-author/data-replies/data-resolved), track changes, TOC navs (data-kind=figures/toc), drop caps, text art, footnotes/header/footer parts.

YOUR DELIVERABLES:
1. In-page round-trip probe (same Playwright recipe as BUG2 — reuse scripts/smoke.mjs helpers or a new scripts/roundtrip.mjs, same absolute-require playwright, python3 http.server port 18044): build a document exercising EVERY marking feature (spellcheck ON with misspellings present, text direction set, a comment + reply, track changes on with an edit, table with cell alignment + vertical align, chart, image, content control, TOC + table of figures, drop cap, header/footer). Then trigger the REAL serialization (call the same function the save button path calls — probe how flush/save serializes; if it needs the bridge, stub fetch to capture the payload instead of POSTing). Assert on the payload: (a) zero .wo-misspelled spans, (b) no aria-pressed / data-cmd / internal-only attrs on document content (compare against what the converters actually parse — grep the converter's expected markup for header/footer/TOC if visible in comments), (c) data-textdir/data-kind/data-spec/data-author etc. SURVIVE (they are document semantics), (d) HTML is well-formed (basic tag-balance check).
2. Reload round-trip: load the captured payload back (set editor.innerHTML = payload via a probe page or by serving a fixture), re-run a serialization — output must be stable (idempotent) and error-free.
3. Fix every leak found (extend strip/allowlist at the serialization point — root cause, not per-feature patches) and every feature that does NOT survive (if a converter-documented markup exists, emit that markup).
4. Test file roundtrip.test.mjs: node-side asserts — (a) the serialization function contains stripper coverage for each internal marker class (grep-level: wo-misspelled, aria-pressed, data-cmd), (b) allowlist includes data-textdir/data-kind/data-spec/data-author/data-resolved/data-replies, (c) the roundtrip script exists. ALL *.test.mjs green (28 files).
5. Commit: 'fix(BUG3-SERIALIZATION-SAFETY): save/export round-trip cleanliness across all feature markup' + body.
